title: Romblon town suspends classes, school work on Oct. 5 for Teachers’ Day

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY — The local government of Cajidiocan in Romblon has suspended classes in all public elementary and secondary schools on Oct. 5 in observance of National Teachers’ Day and World Teachers’ Day. The suspension also covers work for teaching and non-teaching personnel in public schools, according to Executive Order No. 073, series of 2026,
